articles.title: Bitcoin holds above $83,000 ahead of U.S. inflation data as altcoins lag
articles.snippet: Bitcoin briefly reached $84,000 before easing back, while the CoinDesk 80 fell 0.6% since midnight as traders waited for U.S. inflation data.

articles.title: Bitcoin keeps up pressure on $84K as US stocks skirt Korea tech sell-off
articles.snippet: Bitcoin price action preserved overnight gains as US stocks quickly rebounded after opening lower on the back of Korea’s tech-stock rout.
